annotations.text:
Gestures (real hardware map)
swipe: move highlight / scroll
right-temple tap or R1 ring: select / confirm
left-temple double-tap: menu open or close
right double-tap: system exit dialog

This IS the real display: 576x288, 16 green levels on transparent glass, worn while walking.
Brightness tiers here mirror firmware textColor 4/3/2/1 (bright = content, dim = chrome).
Text only in v1 - the selection border on lists is drawn by firmware.
Each frame = one state of the same 5-container page; Menu and Messages are the list layout.

Navigation model: Home is the assistant at rest. Left double-tap opens Menu - the capability nav. Each entry opens its data view (Messages shown; Notifications, Calendar, Mail follow the same list pattern). Voice cuts across everything: say JOAT + ask from any screen.
